changeSet.author: KJ
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE email ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, student_id BIGINT NOT NULL, course_id BIGINT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, teacher_id BIGINT, sent_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_email_student FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_email_teacher FOREIGN KEY (teacher_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL );
